mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during monetary easing cycles, or the 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% during a tightening cycle, or the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both the federal funds rate and economic demand (GDP) signals a dual pressure scenario, where rising rates compress valuations while strong demand supports equity prices, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 both increase simultaneously
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase simultaneously over 60-day periods, or the returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in economic demand (GDP) growth signals robust consumer and business activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during periods of rising GDPC1, or the 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in economic demand (GDP) above 18,500 billion chained 2017 dollars signals robust growth, driving corporate profits and equity valuations higher, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances where GDPC1 crosses above 18,500, or the 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% during a monetary tightening cycle raises discount rates, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% during a tightening cycle, or the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in supply-side indicators (industrial production) signals robust manufacturing activity, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during periods of rising INDPRO, or the 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, reducing supply constraints and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances where INDPRO crosses above 105.0, or the 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in such periods.
